name: Gas Guzzler / boost-mechanologist-unblocked
notes: Printed Gas Guzzler yellow is a Mechanologist attack action with cost3, power5, and exactly Boost. CR8.3.9 makes banishing the top deck card optional additional cost; banishing a Mechanologist grants this attack go again, while other top cards do not. Empty deck prevents paying Boost but does not prevent ordinary play. Dash young has only an optional start-game item setup ability, and no item is started in these main-phase fixtures. No Hyper Driver, Teklo Pounder, High Octane, equipment or other boost modifiers exist. Ordinary Boost grants no permission to play its zero-cost banished card; while AP1 and resources suffice, that play must still reject.  Payment-order correction from independent review: the Boost modal declares the optional cost early (CR5.1.3b). With positive resource cost, accepting before pitching leaves original Deck intact/Banish0, AP1/resources0 and priority1. Pay resource/AP asset costs first (CR5.1.7-8), then actually banish the top card as the effect-cost (CR5.1.9), before opponent priority. The two action checkpoints detect eager banishing before pitch, but same-action post-payment outcomes alone do not establish internal AP-before-banish ordering; a paired shared-path witness must cover that internal order.
